excerpt.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]停靠在我们舰队边上，广播着重复的信号。

翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出一位代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
excerpt.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] drew alongside our fleet, broadcasting a repeating signal.

It was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]派遣了一艘舰船到我们的边境上，广播着重复的信号。

翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出以为代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] stationed a vessel at our border, broadcasting a repeating signal.

It was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange event on their ship.
